scripts.generate: export HEY_HEY_OPENAPI_ROOT="$PWD/openapi" && pnpm --filter @hey-hey/ui-common generate:all && pnpm --filter ./apps/cli generate && pnpm --filter ./apps/api db:generate && pnpm --filter ./apps/api generate:all
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./apps/ui build && pnpm --filter ./apps/cli build && pnpm --filter ./apps/api build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @hey-hey/ui-common build && pnpm --filter ./apps/ui type-check && pnpm --filter ./apps/ui test && pnpm --filter ./apps/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter ./apps/cli test
